## About Platform
This is the verified SEO, AEO, AIO, GEO, E-E-A-T Multi-Engine Diagnostic Platform.
Provides real-time analysis across Traditional SEO, Answer Engine direct snippets, AI Overviews, Generative LLM citations, and Experience-Expertise-Authoritativeness-Trustworthiness.

## Core Multi-Engine Standards
- SEO: Canonical protocol, HTML semantic hierarchy, H1 single instance, 50-60 character title, 150-160 character description
- AEO: Question and answer format, FAQ Schema, concise direct answers under 50 words
- AIO: Machine-readable JSON-LD Schema graph, microdata triples
- GEO: Generative engine grounding, author entity credentials, knowledge graph citation
- E-E-A-T: Verifiable author experience, LinkedIn sameAs links, Google Quality Rater compliance
